audit_items.proof_trace: When total_supply == 0, exchange_rate() unconditionally returns from_quotient(1,1) = 1.0 (L93-94) regardless of cash/debt/cash_reserve state, so int_div(collateral_amount, 1.0) = WAD*amt/WAD = amt exactly (zero truncation). All donation-like paths that increase cash without minting ctokens (repay_amount overpayment, increase_reserve_only for flash loan fees) add an equal amount to cash_reserve, leaving the exchange rate numerator (cash+debt-cash_reserve) invariant — inflation attack via direct token donation is structurally impossible in Sui Move.
